description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android application. It provides a method for outputting log messages, potentially as part of a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that can output logs and potentially pass them along to other nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
